import hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
work=root/"benchmark/results/lower-density-2026-10-15/work"
freeze=work/"freeze.json"
expected_sha="ae32f7ffc4cd17c04885d04e6480528882e0b274e61025097206c087a7429ece"
assert hashlib.sha256(freeze.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected_sha
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("independent_lower_work_readiness",work/"collect.py")
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
entry=module.parent.check_freeze
value=module.check_freeze(freeze)
assert module.parent.check_freeze is entry
assert value["parent_work_freeze_sha256"]=="e9b556e7d92bb0c73597a185112170ed649752957e64a484f44770887a331d04"
counts=dict(expected_children=60,expected_solver_outputs=180,counter_cells=11700,unmeasured_hash_cells=120,replay_chains=120,query_rows=60,topology_twins=30)
for key,expected in counts.items():assert type(value[key]) is int and value[key]==expected
cases=[(f"{family}_n{n}_d{density}_p0",family,n,density) for density,sizes in ((16,(512,2048,8192,32768,131072,524288,2097152)),(8,(256,1024,4096,16384,65536,262144,1048576,4194304))) for n in sizes for family in ("leaf_distance4","leaf_shuffled4")]
expected=[("eighth",case,family,n,density,n*density,graph,3407) for graph,order in ((23000003,cases),(23000029,cases[::-1])) for case,family,n,density in order]
actual=[tuple(row[key] for key in ("variant","case_id","family","n","density","m","graph_seed","kkt_seed")) for row in value["schedule"]]
assert actual==expected and len(set(actual))==60
assert set(value["variants"])=={"eighth"}
assert value["child_deadline_seconds"]==1800
assert len(value["counter_fields"])==65 and len(value["selected_fields"])==8
assert not (work/"capture-attempt01.json").exists()
assert hashlib.sha256(freeze.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected_sha
print(json.dumps(dict(validation="pass",freeze=str(freeze),freeze_sha256=expected_sha,bound_files=len(value["bound_sha256"]),parent_entrypoint_preserved=True,checked_schedule=60,fields=65,selected_fields=8,native_solver_execution=False,counts=counts),indent=2))
